title: Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (HBOT) for Diabetic Wounds
description: CMS coverage for systemic hyperbaric oxygen therapy in diabetic lower extremity wounds. Requires documented type 1 or 2 diabetes, Wagner Grade III or deeper ulceration (deep tissue, tendon, bone involvement, or osteomyelitis), and failure of >= 30 days of standard conservative wound therapy.

criteria.name: Diabetic Foot Ulcer Severity (Wagner Grade >= 3)
criteria.description: Documented lower extremity diabetic wound classified as Wagner Grade 3 or deeper (involving deep tissue, capsule, tendon, or osteomyelitis).
criteria.clinical_intent: Mandatory tissue depth and severity threshold

criteria.name: Failure of Standard Conservative Wound Therapy >= 30 Days
criteria.description: Documented trial of standard conservative wound management for >= 30 days without significant healing.
criteria.clinical_intent: Ensure medical conservative therapy before hyperbaric intervention
